title: FuseScope Collector
description: Monitor the FuseScope Collector itself: refused and dropped data, export queues, ClickHouse inserts and RUM refusals
overview:
### Monitor the FuseScope Collector

The FuseScope Collector writes its own telemetry, the `otelcol_*` metrics of its receivers, exporters and queues, to the same storage as the data it receives, under `service.name` `fusescope-collector`. This integration reads it.

#### What you get

- **Alerts** on data the collector refuses, fails to receive or drops on export, on ClickHouse insert errors, on export queues over half full, on RUM refusals that point at the collector rather than at clients, and on the collector's telemetry going missing. Each alert names the replica (`host.name`) and the receiver, exporter, table or reason involved.
- **A dashboard** with the same signals per replica and component, the collector's memory, and how many replicas report.

The alerts follow the notification policies of your organization.

configuration.title: Prerequisites
configuration.instructions:
The FuseScope Collector of the FuseScope chart writes its own telemetry while `fusescopeCollector.selfMetrics.enabled` is `true`, the default:

```yaml
fusescopeCollector:
  selfMetrics:
    enabled: true
    scrapeInterval: 60s
```

The alerts compare two 10-minute windows, so keep `scrapeInterval` at 5 minutes or less.

Only the gateway's telemetry is covered. Traffic from FuseScope agents shows on the gateway as the receiver `otlp/agents`; the agents' own telemetry is not collected yet.

configuration.title: Alerts
configuration.instructions:
Each alert compares two adjacent 10-minute windows, so a single blip does not fire, and is evaluated per replica (`host.name`) and component; one replica in trouble alerts on its own.

| Alert | Severity | Fires when |
|---|---|---|
| receiver-refused | critical | a receiver refuses data, by the memory limiter among others, in both windows |
| receiver-failed | critical | a receiver fails to take data in, in both windows |
| export-dropped | critical | `fusescope_clickhouse` or `fusescope_clickhouse/meter` fails to send or enqueue data |
| clickhouse-insert-errors | warning | INSERT attempts into a table fail in both windows |
| queue-backing-up | warning | an exporter queue is over half full in both windows |
| rum-policy-unavailable | critical | RUM requests are refused because the collector holds no ingest policy, in both windows |
| rum-backpressure | warning | RUM requests are refused because the collector or its pipeline is busy, in both windows |
| no-telemetry | critical | no telemetry from the collector for 10 minutes, including when it never reported |

There is no default memory alert: the memory limiter's limit is a share of the container's memory limit, which the collector does not report, and its refusals already raise receiver-refused. RUM refusals by key, origin, signal or rate limit depend on the clients and have no portable baseline: the dashboard shows them by reason.

display.name: FuseScope Collector Overview
display.description: The FuseScope Collector's own telemetry: receivers, exporters, queues, ClickHouse inserts, memory and RUM refusals.

display.name: Resident memory by replica
display.description: No default alert: the memory limiter's limit is a share of the container limit, which is not reported; its refusals show above.

display.name: ClickHouse insert duration p95 by table
display.description: 95th percentile of each INSERT attempt's duration, retries included.

display.name: Failed by receiver
display.description: Items a receiver failed to take in; alerted by receiver-failed.

display.name: Export failures by exporter
display.description: Items an exporter failed to send or enqueue, so dropped; alerted by export-dropped.

display.name: ClickHouse insert errors by table
display.description: Failed INSERT attempts, retryable or permanent; alerted by clickhouse-insert-errors. distributed_samples is the meter's table.

display.name: RUM requests refused by reason
display.description: no_policy, busy and consumer_retryable are alerted; the other reasons depend on clients and limits, with no portable baseline.

display.name: Replicas reporting
display.description: Collector replicas whose telemetry arrives; the no-telemetry alert fires when none does.

display.name: Refused by receiver
display.description: Items refused, by the memory limiter among others; alerted by receiver-refused.

display.name: Sent by exporter
display.description: Items each exporter sent, per second.

display.name: Accepted by receiver
display.description: Items each receiver accepted, per second.

display.name: Export queue usage
display.description: Share of each exporter queue in use; alerted by queue-backing-up above 50%.

spec.name: A
spec.query: max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}) / max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0)

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
  or max by ("host.name", receiver) (increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
)

alerts.alert: FuseScope Collector export queue backing up

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"})
  / max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0)
)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m)
  / max by ("host.name", exporter, data_type) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m > 0)
) > 0.5

annotations.description: Queue backing up: queue_size / queue_capacity above 50% in two checks in a row, for fusescope_clickhouse and fusescope_clickhouse/meter (CUTOVER.md §4).
annotations.summary: The {{index $labels "data_type"}} queue of exporter {{index $labels "exporter"}} on {{index $labels "host.name"}} is over half full

)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", reason) (increase(otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", reason="no_policy"} offset 20m))

annotations.description: RUM refused with reason busy or consumer_retryable: increases in two checks in a row (structural, needs no baseline) (CUTOVER.md §4).
No telemetry: no row for fusescope-collector for 10 minutes; also fires when it never reported (CUTOVER.md §4).
annotations.summary: No telemetry from fusescope-collector for 10 minutes: the collector or its self-metrics are down
